aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:862.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Manager of Employee Engagement will play a pivotal role in driving employee engagement and optimizing the employee experience across AEG's operations. This position will involve providing input on the overall employee engagement strategy for internal company events, initiatives, and programs, while serving as a business partner to support internal business lines in their communication needs. This position will report to the Sr. Director, Employee Engagement and partner with various departments such as Diversity, Equity & Inclusion, Human Resources, Creative Services, Corporate Communications, External Affairs, etc. Essential Functions Heavy contribution with developing, implementing, and evaluating a comprehensive engagement program aimed at increasing employee retention and fostering a culture of inclusion. An example includes, AEG Service Awards. Partner with the Internal Communications Manager for internal communications, executive communications, and employee events, supporting collateral for AEG Backstage, and establish effective two-way communication channels between employees and management. Provide leadership, coaching and development to staff. Work with leadership and other departments (DEI, HR, Corporate Communications), to understand the voice of the employee, identify opportunities that will help drive employee satisfaction, retention, and performance; and help create programming that supports these drivers. This includes, but is not limited to working with Human Resources on Health & Well-Being initiatives DEI – Employee Network Groups etc. Utilize proactive analytics across survey projects to identify actions and interventions in support of a positive workplace. Work closely with the Survey team to deploy the Global MyVoice Engagement Survey along with any other surveys throughout the year. Support Employee Engagement Specialist with planning, producing, and executing bi-annual company meeting, AEG Connect Summit with Sr. Director of Employee Engagement along with Summit Planning Committee. Partner with our EE Events position to plan, produce, execute All Staff Meetings at least 2x/year. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) 5+ years related work experience Experience leading, mentoring, and/or coaching teams is preferred Experience in a large highly matrixed organization is preferred Ability to engage effectively with all levels of the organization, both internally and externally, fostering strong relationships and promoting a positive company image. Demonstrated experience in change management and/or project management, ensuring successful implementation of initiatives. Proficiency in managing corporate intranets and other communications technologies. Excellent public speaking and event planning expertise to deliver impactful communications. Strong organization and time management skills, self-motivated with the ability to achieve results with minimal s

aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:ebb8db9d-.title: Sales Manager
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:ebb8db9d-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:ebb8db9d-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Gamma has proven product-market fit with over 70 million users, and now we're building the B2B sales engine to match. As Sales Manager, you'll lead our West Coast sales team from Gamma's San Francisco headquarters, coaching 6–8 high-performing AEs at the center of our product-led growth engine. This is a builder role. You won't inherit a finished machine; you'll create repeatable processes, set the bar for how Gamma shows up in every customer interaction, and scale the team without losing quality. With direct access to our founders and product team, you'll shape how Gamma wins in B2B at a company moving with startup speed and growth-stage traction. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Coach, develop, and hold accountable a team of AEs across enterprise and commercial segments, running pipeline reviews, deal strategy sessions, and 1:1s that move the needle - Build repeatable sales processes from the ground up, including qualification frameworks, forecasting cadences, and deal progression criteria that let the team scale cleanly - Own your team's number, forecasting with precision, managing pipeline health, and ensuring every rep has a clear path to quota - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales Ops to translate field signals into company-wide action - Recruit and close top-tier AE talent as the team grows, keeping the bar high - Set the standard for how Gamma shows up in every customer interaction WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 3–6+ years of frontline sales management at a high-growth SaaS or AI company, with a consistent track record of teams hitting quota - Experience managing both enterprise and commercial sales motions, with the ability to coach across different ACVs and selling cycles - A builder mindset. You've stood up processes, not just inherited them, and you know what good looks like at scale because you've built it before - Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain top talent. Your former reps would follow you to the next company - Strong forecasting discipline and a data-informed approach to pipeline management, paired with deep comfort in fast-moving, ambiguous environments - Experience in PLG or product-led environments, a background selling creative tools, AI products, or horizontal SaaS platforms; experience building a team in a new market or geography (Nice to have) COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $200K-$215K, plus benefits & equity. This role also includes variable compensation tied directly to your team's success — when they win, you win. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

Your job is to gather real-world input from interviews, surveys, events, strategic partners, and market activity, and turn it into clear insights that shape what we publish, what we build, and how we grow our subscriber base. This is not a traditional editing role. It is about identifying patterns, making sense of information, and helping the organization make better decisions based on real audience needs. Your work will directly improve content quality, increase conversion, and drive audience growth.

cordance-cordance:greenhouse:5392784008.title: Marketing Operations Manager
cordance-cordance:greenhouse:5392784008.description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Overview of the Position We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and data-driven Marketing Operations Manager to own the reporting, measurement, and operational intelligence that enable Marketing leadership to make informed business decisions. This role serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Data Engineering — translating business needs into scalable reporting frameworks, standardized operating processes, and AI-enabled insights across multiple business units. This is a data- and systems-oriented role: the ideal candidate brings strong technical and analytical fluency, not a marketing-generalist background, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment. The ideal candidate is a curious, highly analytical, and results-oriented professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, process, and technology — not a marketer who moved into operations. They are comfortable partnering with both business and technical stakeholders, translating ambiguous questions into reporting and operational solutions, and are excited to contribute to the evolution of Marketing Operations through automation and AI. Core Responsibilities Marketing Performance & Analytics Analyze Marketing performance across the funnel, pipeline, marketing-originated bookings, and campaign effectiveness to identify trends, opportunities, and risks, in close collaboration with Marketing and Data teams. Ensure data accuracy and timeliness across automated performance scorecarding for lead-to-opportunity conversion, marketing-originated bookings, and marketing return on investment (ROMI), across all in-scope business units. Analyze marketing budget performance and spend attainment to support planning and investment decisions. Reporting & Business Intelligence Own the Marketing reporting suite within the centralized BI/reporting layer, ensuring reports remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with business needs. Partner with the Data Engineering team to define reporting requirements, prioritize enhancements, and validate completed work through business acceptance testing (QA/UAT). Develop and maintain standardized reporting documentation, metric definitions, and reporting logic. Marketing Measurement & Operations Develop and refine measurement frameworks for campaign performance, attribution, lead scoring, pipeline source-mix tracking, and marketing ROI. Create and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve marketing operations efficiency, consistency, and scalability across business units. Optimize lead enrichment and lead routing processes to ensure data accuracy and seamless marketing-to-sales handoffs, including qualification standards prior to sales conversion. Design and manage GTM cadences to align Marketing, Sales Development, and Sales teams for effective execution and pipeline growth. AI & Reporting Automation Support the development and operationalization of AI-enabled reporting and business insights for Marketing. Assist in the design and continuous improvement of automated reporting pr

distro-distro:lever:fba09c80-f823-4486-a.description: We are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you. About Us • Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector. • We provide a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). • We serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. • Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, we help thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations. • Learn more at www.vensure.com. Position Summary • Title: Payroll Tax Supervisor • Responsibilities include daily payroll tax processes covering federal, state, and local payroll tax compliance. • Preparation of various payroll tax payments and returns. • Training new department staff and providing essential tools for success. • Strong problem-solving skills and customer service orientation required. • Must develop relationships with clients across different industries and personalities. • Knowledge of the PEO model is required. Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Ensure timely federal, state, and local tax payments for multi-state entities. • Understand PEO and ASO organizations related to state filing requirements. • Manage reports and filings for CFO for AUP quarterly tax audits. • Develop new guidelines and procedures for payroll tax processes. • Train and assist in resolving complex tax reconciliations, variances, credits, and errors. • Supervise and train staff to ensure quality daily processes and tax notice resolution. • Manage EFTPS enrollments, annual wage reconciliation, payroll tax adjustments, W-2, and W-2C preparation. • Maintain professional and technical payroll tax knowledge through workshops and research. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities • Minimum 3 years of multi-state, multi-jurisdiction, high-volume payroll tax experience. • At least 1 year of recent senior, lead, or supervisor experience. • Preferred experience in PEO or related industry. • Hands-on tax return processing experience required. • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local wage laws. • MasterTax and Prism/HRP experience preferred. • Ability to analyze complex regulatory tax notices and data. • Results-oriented with multi-tasking ability in a fast-paced environment. • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail. • Work independently and collaboratively with strong service skills. • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills. Education & Experience • Minimum 5 years multi-state payroll tax processing experience. • MasterTax and HR Pyramid experience preferred. • Minimum 2 years multi-state payroll tax return preparation and high volume experience. • Proficient in MS Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), WebEx, and Internet. • Strong technical, time management, and organizational skills. Required Licenses and/or Certifications • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamentals of Payroll Certification (FPC) required. Physical Demands • Frequently required to sit; occasionally stand and walk. • Vision requirements include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. • Frequently required to talk and hear. • Moderate concentration and prolonged mental effort. • Average memory. • Noise level usually moderate. This position is eligible for the following benefits. #SolvoHRGlobal #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Onsite

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Senior Scientist, Discovery Technologies
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: What if… you could join an organization that creates, resources, and builds life sciences companies that invent breakthrough technologies in order to transform health care and sustainability? Flagship Labs 129 (FL129) is an early-stage biotechnology startup with an ambitious and exciting mission: to develop a technology to facilitate the data generation necessary for training the next generation of generative chemistry models to unlock the future of small molecule drug discovery. FL129 is developing a revolutionary approach to this challenge and is recruiting a team of top-tier scientists to build this powerful and first-in-category platform. This is a unique opportunity to be one of the first employees of a biotech startup that combines an innovative mindset with the resources and know-how of Flagship Pioneering. Position Summary: We are seeking a motivated and highly collaborative Senior Scientist to join FL129’s growing team of experimental and computational scientists to build a novel platform technology. The successful candidate will have strong track record of scientific and technical innovation in molecular biology and small molecule screening, including experience adapting screens to cell- or surface-displayed protein targets. Additional experience with or exposure to yeast surface display, single-cell or genomics methods, and cheminformatics are preferred. The ideal teammate will be highly adaptable, have strong organizational and communication skills, and will thrive in a highly collaborative and multidisciplinary environment. Key Responsibilities: Technology development , aligned with FL129’s core strategic goals. This role is among the first hires, and we’re looking for someone who thinks critically and will influence the company’s scientific direction. Design, construction, and experimental testing of custom target/variant libraries, including binding assays against cell- or surface-displayed protein targets Optimize existing workflows and establish best experimental and documentation practices to enable platform excellence. Ensuring rapid and accurate turnaround of data to drive achievement of key project goals. Translate experimental data into meaningful insights and present results at team meetings. Preferred Qualifications: Ph.D. in molecular biology, systems biology, chemical biology, or a similar field with 5+ years of industry or postdoctoral experience. End-to-end experience with small molecule screening from library design, including optimization of DNA tags for amplification, quantitation and sequencing, to screening, next-gen sequencing, to data analysis. Experience managing contract research organizations (CROs). Nice to have: cheminformatics experience, on-DNA and off-DNA hit validation experience with DNA-encoded positive control and library compounds, surface display technologies, droplet-based screening and/or microfluidics, and single-cell or genomics methods. Motivated team-player and independent force-of-nature with strong organizational and written/verbal communication skills. What we can offer you: Opportunity to lay the scientific foundation of a transformative platform company as an early employee. Custom-tailored role to maximize impactful contributions, professional growth, and scientific interests. Weekly lunches, monthly social events, and community lunchroom with free snacks, coffee, all embedded in a vibrant community of scientists and entrepreneurs across multiple Flagship Pioneering portfolio companies. We are seeking individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit, strong communication skills, and comfort in working in and contributing to a dynamic and cross-functional team environment. The level of the role will be commensurate with the education and years of experience of the identified candidates. jobgether-jobgether:lever:299d0665-2f13-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Data) based in Portugal. This is an opportunity to join a lean, autonomous engineering team building products that help organizations better understand and optimize cloud data costs. You’ll play a key role in designing and delivering new capabilities across backend systems, data engineering, visualization, and cost-management workflows. The position offers meaningful ownership, with the opportunity to shape technical direction and influence the product roadmap. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers and founding team members in a fast-moving environment where pragmatic decisions and customer impact matter. From data pipelines and transformation models to resilient application components, your work will directly improve the product experience. The role is ideal for a self-directed engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, moving quickly, and owning features from concept through release. You’ll also have the flexibility and autonomy of a distributed team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and sustainable ways of working. Design and build new product capabilities focused on data cost management, including forecasting, anomaly detection, cost allocation, and related workflows. Develop reliable and reusable backend and data-engineering solutions that surface actionable insights for customers. Build data pipelines and transformation models that support new product capabilities and identify opportunities for optimization. Create and improve data visualization features that communicate performance, query timing, efficiency, and other important metrics clearly. Develop resilient, reusable UI components that contribute to a smooth and intuitive product experience. Improve application reliability, scalability, and performance through thoughtful engineering practices and system design. Own features end to end, from identifying problems and shaping requirements through technical design, implementation, testing, and release. Evaluate technical and product tradeoffs to prioritize high-impact solutions and deliver meaningful customer value efficiently. Collaborate closely with engineers and senior stakeholders through clear proposals, documentation, code reviews, testing, and effective communication. Contribute to a culture of pragmatic execution, continuous improvement, and strong engineering quality. Requirements 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong expertise in backend development and data engineering. Strong working knowledge of Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, dbt, Dagster, and Snowflake . Solid understanding of system design and the ability to develop scalable, reliable technical solutions. Experience building data pipelines, transformation workflows, backend services, and data-driven product capabilities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed environment. Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain accountable for outcomes from initial concept through delivery. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment when balancing speed, technical depth, and customer impact. Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment where priorities and requirements may change. Strong collaboration skills and a commitment to readable, maintainable code, clear documentation, and thorough testing. A proactive, curious, and positive approach to engineering, with genuine enthusiasm for solving challenging problems. Familiarity with FinOps, cloud infrastructure cost management, data-warehouse management, or observability is a plus. Previous experience working in an early-stage startup or similarly lean engineering environment is advantageous. Benefits Base salary of up to $180,000 CAD , plus additional compensation opport

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b7d7f8d4-dd5e-.title: Operations Supervisor
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b7d7f8d4-dd5e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Operations Supervisor based in United Arab Emirates. This is a remote operations leadership role focused on scaling and maintaining a high-performing distributed workforce. You will work closely with the Operations Manager to translate broader objectives into effective day-to-day execution. Your focus will include workforce planning, attendance, quality assurance, coaching, onboarding, and operational administration. You will help grow the operation toward a target of 100 active agents while maintaining consistent performance and reliability. The role suits a hands-on operational leader who is comfortable managing people, monitoring performance, and addressing issues quickly. Strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail will be essential to keeping the operation running smoothly as it expands. Work closely with the Operations Manager to execute daily operational priorities and ensure activities remain aligned with broader business objectives. Manage and maintain an accurate roster of active agents, applying established policies to identify inactive agents and coordinate timely replacements. Monitor agent attendance and schedules to ensure team members consistently complete their required 8-hour daily shifts. Conduct daily test calls and quality checks to verify that agents meet established quality standards and operational expectations. Provide timely, constructive coaching and follow-up when quality issues, complaints, or performance concerns arise. Support workforce growth and capacity planning with the objective of building and maintaining a team of up to 100 active agents. Manage onboarding and compliance activities by reviewing required documentation, communicating status updates, and maintaining organized records. Calculate, prepare, and submit the operation’s monthly minutes-based invoice accurately and on time. Track operational performance, identify gaps, and take appropriate corrective action to maintain productivity, quality, and workforce stability. Requirements Demonstrated experience in operations, workforce management, team supervision, customer support, or a related operational environment. Strong ability to manage distributed or remote teams while maintaining accountability for attendance, productivity, and quality. Experience monitoring performance against defined standards and providing constructive coaching when issues arise. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate rosters, schedules, documentation, and operational records. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, operational tracking systems, and basic financial or invoicing information. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with agents, managers, and clients. Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with operational leadership. Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on team growth, quality, attendance, and consistent execution. Benefits Base salary: $200 per month. Performance-based bonus: 1% of the operation’s total gross monthly invoice. Bonus eligibility: The performance bonus becomes available once more than 20 active agents are maintained while completing their required 8-hour shifts. Growth-based earning potential: Compensation increases as the size and gross invoice value of the operation grows. Target earning example: At 100 active agents, the minimum gross monthly invoice is approximately $84,400, generating a minimum $844 performance bonus. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE Vice President of Sales - KSA As we expand into the Middle East, Cognition is looking for a Vice President of Sales to launch and scale our operations in KSA. This role is for an experienced executive who can build the full KSA business from scratch. You will lead go-to-market, establish commercial and government partnerships, hire cross-functional teams, build and scale a direct and partnerships team, with the necessary supporting functions and drive Cognition's footprint across the region. You will be responsible for setting the strategy, driving revenue, managing the local P and L, and ensuring exceptional customer experience. The ideal candidate combines enterprise sales experience with operational leadership, and has built or scaled high-growth technology organisations in KSA.
